[...] Only sees what you already see. readywhen inherits your WhatsApp Business permissions. If someone can’t access something in WhatsApp Business, neither can readywhen.

 Never trains on your data. Your WhatsApp Business data is never used to train, fine-tune, or improve any AI model, ours or any third party’s.
 Enterprise security standards. ISO 27001 certified and GDPR-compliant, with a Data Processing Agreement available on request. Encrypted in transit and at rest. SOC 2 Type II is underway. [...] Read the full security overview →

## Commonly used with WhatsApp Business and readywhen

Work rarely stays in just WhatsApp Business. readywhen picks up your commitments no matter where they happen.

 HubSpot
 Gmail
 Google Calendar
 Notion

## WhatsApp Business connector FAQ

1. Does readywhen read private channels and DMs? 

Only in conversations where readywhen has been added. It cannot access private channels it hasn't been invited to.

   2. Do I need to be an admin to install WhatsApp Business? 

Workspace settings determine that. readywhen works in both admin-installed and user-installed setups.
